'''Thrower trolls''' are monsters found on the [[frozen floors]] of [[Daemonheim]]. They use [[ranged]], and are thus susceptible to [[melee]] attacks and resistant to [[magic]]. Like all trolls, they are very weak to [[slash]] and [[stab]] attacks, and have a slight resistance to [[crush]] attacks.

==Trivia==
* These trolls, along with the other creatures in Daemonheim (such as dragons and dogs) use an updated graphical style when compared to their counterparts found elsewhere.
* Occasionally, during combat, these trolls will exclaim "Urgh!"
